verdict.rationale: Casium is a SaaS immigration platform with a client portal, so API parity with the UI is a fair question, but the evidence pack never mentions a public API. Probes for OpenAPI and Swagger specs all returned 404, and llms.txt also returned 404. No evidence shows any UI action is exposed programmatically.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
